A minecart with furnace is a furnace inside a minecart. It can be powered with coal or charcoal to propel it across a rail line for a limited time, which can be used to move other minecarts.

page.overview:
What is Minecart with Furnace?

A minecart with furnace is a furnace inside a minecart. It can be powered with coal or charcoal to propel it across a rail line for a limited time, which can be used to move other minecarts.

Minecarts with furnace can be retrieved by attacking them, and doing so drops a furnace and a minecart.

Minecarts with furnaces are placed in the same way as other minecarts. It does not have a graphical user interface, unlike a furnace.

Minecarts with furnaces can be powered, done by feeding fuel (coal or charcoal) into the furnace minecart with the button. The fuel is consumed immediately and it starts to move in the same direction the player clicked toward. Pressing always turns it to that direction, even when not holding coal.
